description: This file defines a PHP trait 'CsrfTokenManagerTrait' within the 'OrangeHRM\Authentication\Traits' namespace. The trait provides a method to access a CSRF token manager service from a dependency injection container, facilitating CSRF protection within the OrangeHRM authentication module.

methods.name: getCsrfTokenManager
methods.description: Returns an instance of CsrfTokenManager by retrieving it from the dependency injection container.
